name: metabolism-pathways
label: Metabolism pathways
description: Route of biotransformation. Name the specific enzyme in the term where one is known, and repeat it in the `enzyme` field for display.

terms.label: CYP450 oxidation (unspecified isoform)
terms.note: Retained so v1.0 records still resolve. Use the specific isoform term instead; a record using this term cannot be found by an isoform query.

terms.label: Glucuronidation
terms.note: Phase II. Not a CYP route, so CYP inhibitors and inducers do not touch it. This is the whole reason temazepam and triazolam behave so differently in a polypharmacy setting.

terms.label: Not systemically absorbed
terms.note: Use for agents that act luminally and are excreted unchanged in faeces. Records the absence of systemic disposition as a positive fact rather than an empty pharmacokinetics array.
